about_short_description.short_description: Gulf Cooperation Council Interconnection Authority is an energy organisation that operates a power grid interconnection system.

product.name: GCC Power Grid Interconnection Network
product.description: A regional power grid linking the electricity networks of GCC member countries to enable shared electricity supply and enhance grid reliability.

product.name: Electricity Market Platform
product.description: A platform facilitating electricity trading and exchange among GCC countries to optimize energy resources and support regional cooperation.

product.name: GCCIA Control Centre
product.description: A centralized facility that monitors and manages the interconnected GCC power grid to ensure stable and secure electricity supply.

product.name: Gulf Legislation Platform
product.description: An online GCC platform providing unified electronic access to Gulf and member-state legal and legislative documents.
